blocks.text: Qudrati zaraye mein bijli ki kark (lightning), aatish-fishan (volcanoes), jandar cheezon ka galna-sarna (biological decay), jangal ki aag, mitti ke microorganisms aur samandar waghera shamil hain. Bijli karakne par hawa ki N₂ aur O₂ react kar ke NO banati hain. Mitti ke microorganisms bhi hawa ki N₂ istemal kar ke NO banate hain.

blocks.caption: NOₓ ke qudrati zaraye
rows: microbes nitrogen ko badal kar NO banate hain

blocks.prompt: Aandhi-toofan (thunderstorm) mitti mein nitrate kaise pohncha sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Bijli hawa ko itna garam karti hai ke N₂ aur O₂ mil kar NO banate hain, jo NO₂ mein oxidise hoti hai. NO₂ barish ke pani mein hal ho kar nitric aur nitrous acid banati hai, jo mitti mein nitrate ki shakal mein pohnchte hain aur paude unhen istemal karte hain.

items: Qudrati NOₓ: bijli (N₂ + O₂ → 2NO), aatish-fishan, galna-sarna, jangal ki aag, mitti ke microbes, samandar.
